import pymupdf, pathlib
FONT = "/usr/share/fonts/opentype/noto/NotoSansCJK-Regular.ttc"
FIX = pathlib.Path("/workspace/tmp/fixtures")

def make_pdf(path, pages_text):
    doc = pymupdf.open()
    for t in pages_text:
        page = doc.new_page()
        y = 72
        for line in t.splitlines():
            page.insert_text((50, y), line, fontfile=FONT, fontname="cjk", fontsize=11)
            y += 18
    doc.save(path)
    doc.close()

make_pdf(FIX / "synthetic_cv_A.pdf", [
    "张三",
    "12年工作经验 | 人力资源经理",
    "个人优势：熟悉三支柱，擅长绩效薪酬。",
    "2018.03-至今 某机器人公司 人力资源经理，负责招聘机器人算法工程师30人。",
])
make_pdf(FIX / "synthetic_cv_B.pdf", [
    "李四",
    "5年工作经验 | 招聘专员",
    "个人优势：校招经验丰富。无总监经历。",
])
(FIX / "empty.pdf").write_bytes(b"")
(FIX / "corrupt.pdf").write_bytes(b"%PDF-1.7 this is not really a pdf \x00\x01 garbage")
print("fixtures done")
PYEOF
